title: Align Stage2A locomotion gate with production standing shell authority
hypothesis: The existing locomotion request gate can safely open from production BalanceActive_Standing when IsTransitionOwnedShellLocked() is true by runtime-state authority and BridgeShellState is initialized; after the request opens, scripted locomotion steps can continue in LocomotionActiveShell using the established request/authority state without re-evaluating the standing-only request gate.
single_behavior_change: Align gate semantics and continuation semantics only. Do not activate the explicit transition-owned lock, re-enable CMC/capsule, change movement speed, standing gains, policy scales, model conditioning, or the E60 script.
tdd_contract: BalanceActive_Standing plus GameplayShellObservedOnly and initialized BridgeShellState is accepted by the request gate because the standing runtime owns shell authority.
After a successful scripted locomotion step enters LocomotionActiveShell, the next scripted step succeeds without reopening the request gate.
Continuation is denied if policy output becomes inactive, SimRoot was attempted, the request state is not LocomotionRequested, or shell state is uninitialized.
CMC and capsule ownership are unchanged by gate opening.
next_if_supported: Rerun E60 Normal-1 from the clean E61 candidate and evaluate physical locomotion behavior.
